title: Stickman Sniper Pro
description: Peer through a steady sniper scope across rooftop and city missions—read target briefs, line up clean headshots, and take down every mark.
controls: Drag to aim your sniper scope crosshair onto the mission target, then tap or release to fire a precision shot.

zh-CN.title: 火柴人狙击大师
zh-CN.description: 经典高能横版火柴人狙击暗杀：阅读悬赏情报、开倍镜稳准锁定目标要害，一枪毙命完成全套特工任务！
zh-CN.controls: 拖动屏幕移动狙击镜准星瞄准目标头部，找准时机点击开火一击必杀。
